why: Proposal A follows the brief closely: a light grey three-seat sofa, a light wood coffee table, a large neutral rug, a low white TV console, and a lamp, cushion and plant, all in a cohesive light, warm neutral palette that suits the bright room with its grey-brown floor. Proposal B has a sofa in mid grey with brass legs, a dark walnut-and-white TV unit, a brass and marble lamp, and a busy multicolor cushion. These pieces fight with each other and with the light wood table. The rug is also very large for this space, and the sofa is smaller than the three-seater requested.
